title: Dataplex Batch Operations Get Detailed Metadata, Scope Changes
summary: Dataplex introduces a new `BatchOperationMetadata` schema for detailed insights into long-running batch operations. Be aware of breaking changes as several properties within this new schema are explicitly read-only. Additionally, access scopes for `entryLinks.get` have been updated.
details:
The `GoogleCloudDataplexV1BatchOperationMetadata` schema has been added, providing comprehensive details for long-running batch operations. This includes `apiVersion`, `createTime`, `endTime`, `failedRequests`, `requestedCancellation`, `statusMessage`, `target`, and `verb`.

Breaking Change: All these properties within `GoogleCloudDataplexV1BatchOperationMetadata` are now explicitly defined as read-only. If your applications or client libraries were attempting to write to these fields (perhaps through an implicit or undocumented previous behavior), they will now encounter errors. Update your code to treat these fields as immutable.

Furthermore, the `projects.locations.entryGroups.entryLinks.methods.get` method has seen updates to its required scopes. While `https://www.googleapis.com/auth/dataplex.read-write` and `https://www.googleapis.com/auth/dataplex.readonly` are now explicitly supported, one of the previously listed `dataplex.read-write` scopes has been replaced with `https://www.googleapis.com/auth/cloud-platform.read-only`. Review your application's authentication for this method to ensure continued access.
